title: Firmware Binary Comparison Tool - project / region configuration
description: Documentation of the configuration file format. The tool validates files itself (no jsonschema dependency). Addresses may be integers or strings ('0x08000000', '134217728', '08000000h'). Region 'end' addresses are INCLUSIVE.

base_address.description: MCU address of file offset 0 for raw .bin files

merge_gap.description: Join changed runs separated by <= N unchanged bytes (default 0)

gap_fill.description: Optional. Compare bytes present in only one image against this value (e.g. '0xFF' for erased flash). Omit/null = strict: such bytes are always differences.

expected.description: Areas expected to change between builds (version, timestamp, CRC ...). Differences here are reported as EXPECTED CHANGE; everything else is UNEXPECTED.
